# ClearShift V1 Detailed Module Issue Catalog

**Revision:** 2.0 (Approved 30-Issue Standard)  
**Baseline:** ClearShift Project Plan v3.0, SDS v2.0 (CRM, ERP, Migration Kit), and V1 Standardization Plan  
**Target:** V1 completion at Gate G4 (End of Week 8 / Sprint 4)  
**Issue count:** 360 unique issue specifications  
**Scope:** V1 Must requirements only; V2/V3 items are explicit exclusions.  
**Catalog Structure:** 12 Workstreams × 30 Issues = 360 Issues. Ordered ERP (150), CRM (150), Platform (30), PMO (30).

## Maintainer Instructions

This file defines the canonical, ready-to-create V1 issue specifications. Create or update issues in GitHub adhering to the exact titles, fields, acceptance criteria, and role assignments defined below.

### Standard Role Allocation per Business Module (30 Issues = 8/7/8/7)
- **Role 1 (Team Lead & Core Backend):** Issues `01–08` (8 issues)
- **Role 2 (Integration & DevOps):** Issues `09–15` (7 issues)
- **Role 3 (Frontend & Review UI):** Issues `16–23` (8 issues)
- **Role 4 (Data Reliability & QA Lead):** Issues `24–30` (7 issues)

### Required GitHub Fields & Closure Rules
- **Status:** Open at creation.
- **Priority:** P0 blocks Gate G4 / data movement; P1 is required for V1 completion.
- **Type:** Use the Type field as the issue category/label.
- **Target:** Target sprint/gate indicates scheduling, not permission to bypass dependencies.
- **Depends On:** All listed dependencies are hard blockers; an issue cannot start until its dependencies are Done.
- **Definition of Done:** Every acceptance checkbox is evidenced, automated tests pass in CI, and peer review is approved.

---

## Part I — ERP Modules (150 Issues)

### ERP-1 Products and Inventory — Group 6 (30 Issues)

**Entities:** Products, categories, one warehouse, stock levels (`erp1_categories, erp1_products, erp1_warehouses, erp1_stock_levels`)

**Rules:** SKU is unique after documented normalization; units are from the fixed V1 unit list (pcs, kg, g, litre, metre, box); price/tax use decimal types; stock may not become negative (BR-ERP1-01); import never changes raw source values.


## [ERP1-01] ERP-1 Products and Inventory: Schema contract and guarded database migration

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Open |
| Type | Database / Architecture |
| Priority | P0 |
| Owner | Group 6 — Role 1 — Team Lead / Core Developer |
| Target | Sprint 1 — Gate G1 |
| Depends On | PLT-01, PLT-03 |

### Context
**Problem:** ERP-1 Products and Inventory is a primary V1 target module in ClearShift. Its delivery is governed by the SDS and requires production-grade execution for Gate Gate G1.

**Domain Scope:** Owned entities include Products, categories, one warehouse, stock levels (`erp1_categories, erp1_products, erp1_warehouses, erp1_stock_levels`). Non-negotiable business rules: SKU is unique after documented normalization; units are from the fixed V1 unit list (pcs, kg, g, litre, metre, box); price/tax use decimal types; stock may not become negative (BR-ERP1-01); import never changes raw source values.

**Cross-Module Dependencies:** ERP-2 purchase lines; ERP-3 order/invoice lines; CRM-2 quote product/price reads.

**Traceability:** ClearShift Project Plan v3.0, SDS ClearShift ERP v2.0, and V1 Standardization Plan.

### Decision
Implement schema contract and guarded database migration strictly conforming to the pinned ClearShift V1 stack. All implementations must integrate with the shared platform libraries rather than creating duplicate local utilities. Define module-owned PostgreSQL tables, explicit Drizzle types, primary keys, check constraints, foreign keys and forward-only versioned migration.

### Constraints (Non-Negotiable)
- Pinned stack: Node.js 24 LTS, TypeScript strict, Fastify 5, Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL 18.6, React + Vite.
- Zero duplicate platform infrastructure; consume shared auth, UI tokens, outbox, and migration engines.
- All test data must be 100% synthetic; no real personal, customer, or employee data permitted.
- Deterministic exact duplicate matching only; fuzzy scoring and V2 rollback sagas are strictly out of scope.

### Out of Scope
- V2/V3 features (compensating rollback saga, fuzzy duplicate matching, outbound messaging, cloud storage).
- Modifications to schemas owned by other modules without approved API contracts.

### Technical Specification
**Entities & Endpoints:** Bound to Products, categories, one warehouse, stock levels (`erp1_categories, erp1_products, erp1_warehouses, erp1_stock_levels`).
**Operational Logic:** Define module-owned PostgreSQL tables, explicit Drizzle types, primary keys, check constraints, foreign keys and forward-only versioned migration.
**Error Handling:** Conforms to standard error envelope { code, message, details }. HTTP 400 for bad input, 401/403 for auth, 404 for missing records, 409 for conflicts.
**State Transitions:** Enforces strict domain rules: SKU is unique after documented normalization; units are from the fixed V1 unit list (pcs, kg, g, litre, metre, box); price/tax use decimal types; stock may not become negative (BR-ERP1-01); import never changes raw source values.

### Files to Create/Modify
- `packages/backend/src/modules/erp1/*` — Domain logic, schemas, APIs, and adapters
- `packages/frontend/src/modules/erp1/*` — Module UI pages, tables, and forms
- `tests/modules/erp1/*` — Automated unit, contract, and regression test suites

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Fresh database migration applies cleanly on empty PostgreSQL 18.6 schema.
- [ ] Re-running migration is strictly idempotent and safe.
- [ ] PostgreSQL enforces all required foreign keys, NOT NULL, check and unique constraints.
- [ ] All table and column names conform to snake_case and match the approved data dictionary.
- [ ] UUID primary keys and created_at/updated_at timestamps are present on all records.

### Required Closure Evidence
- Linked pull request merged into main with passing CI checks.
- Automated test suite execution reports demonstrating green passes and >= 60% domain coverage.
- Data dictionary, schema definitions, and OpenAPI contract documentation updated.
- Peer review sign-off by another development group.

### Dependencies
Direct prerequisites: PLT-01, PLT-03. Dependent work cannot begin until all listed dependencies are closed with verified evidence.

### Deferred Decisions
None. Scope is strictly locked to approved V1 specifications.

**Error Handling:** Conforms to standard error envelope { code, message, details }. HTTP 400 for bad input, 401/403 for auth, 404 for missing records, 409 for conflicts.
**State Transitions:** Enforces strict domain rules: SKU is unique after documented normalization; units are from the fixed V1 unit list (pcs, kg, g, litre, metre, box); price/tax use decimal types; stock may not become negative (BR-ERP1-01); import never changes raw source values.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Transient failures trigger bounded exponential backoff retries without corrupting idempotency keys.

Non-negotiable business rules: SKU is unique after documented normalization; units are from the fixed V1 unit list (pcs, kg, g, litre, metre, box); price/tax use decimal types; stock may not become negative (BR-ERP1-01); import never changes raw source values.

**Cross-Module Dependencies:** ERP-2 purchase lines; ERP-3 order/invoice lines; CRM-2 quote product/price reads.

**Traceability:** ClearShift Project Plan v3.0, SDS ClearShift ERP v2.0, and V1 Standardization Plan.

Implement module reconciliation proof and gate g4 evidence pack strictly conforming to the pinned ClearShift V1 stack. All implementations must integrate with the shared platform libraries rather than creating duplicate local utilities. Execute end-to-end reconciliation audit proving exact row accounting, link integrity, and compile the signed Gate G4 acceptance pack.

### Constraints (Non-Negotiable)

**Operational Logic:** Execute end-to-end reconciliation audit proving exact row accounting, link integrity, and compile the signed Gate G4 acceptance pack.

Implement module authorization policy integration strictly conforming to the pinned ClearShift V1 stack. - Zero duplicate platform infrastructure; consume shared auth, UI tokens, outbox, and migration engines.
- All test data must be 100% synthetic; no real personal, customer, or employee data permitted.
- Deterministic exact duplicate matching only; fuzzy scoring and V2 rollback sagas are strictly out of scope.

### Out of Scope
- V2/V3 features (compensating rollback saga, fuzzy duplicate matching, outbound messaging, cloud storage).
- Modifications to schemas owned by other modules without approved API contracts.

### Technical Specification
**Entities & Endpoints:** Bound to Vendors, purchase orders and purchase-order lines (`erp2_vendors, erp2_purchase_orders, erp2_po_lines`).
**Operational Logic:** Apply shared JWT authentication and role-based access control (RBAC) hooks across all module API endpoints.
**Error Handling:** Conforms to standard error envelope { code, message, details }. HTTP 400 for bad input, 401/403 for auth, 404 for missing records, 409 for conflicts.
**State Transitions:** Enforces strict domain rules: Vendor master is owned here; PO status transitions are explicit (Draft -> Sent -> Received -> Closed); each PO line references an existing ERP-1 product; total is computed from decimal line values with documented rounding; bank details are masked server-side and excluded from logs/exports.

### Decision
Implement idempotent retry and partial-load stop behavior strictly conforming to the pinned ClearShift V1 stack. All implementations must integrate with the shared platform libraries rather than creating duplicate local utilities. Enforce chunked batch processing, bounded retries, and immediate batch halting when row failures exceed the 10% threshold.

### Constraints (Non-Negotiable)
- Pinned stack: Node.js 24 LTS, TypeScript strict, Fastify 5, Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL 18.6, React + Vite.
- Zero duplicate platform infrastructure; consume shared auth, UI tokens, outbox, and migration engines.
- All test data must be 100% synthetic; no real personal, customer, or employee data permitted.
- Deterministic exact duplicate matching only; fuzzy scoring and V2 rollback sagas are strictly out of scope.

### Out of Scope
- V2/V3 features (compensating rollback saga, fuzzy duplicate matching, outbound messaging, cloud storage).
- Modifications to schemas owned by other modules without approved API contracts.

### Technical Specification
**Entities & Endpoints:** Bound to Sales orders, order lines, invoices and invoice lines (`erp3_sales_orders, erp3_order_lines, erp3_invoices, erp3_invoice_lines`).
**Operational Logic:** Enforce chunked batch processing, bounded retries, and immediate batch halting when row failures exceed the 10% threshold.
**Error Handling:** Conforms to standard error envelope { code, message, details }. HTTP 400 for bad input, 401/403 for auth, 404 for missing records, 409 for conflicts.
**State Transitions:** Enforces strict domain rules: Customer reference resolves through CRM-1/Golden ID mapping; products resolve through ERP-1; totals are computed, not trusted from raw source; due date is mandatory for overdue calculation; one exact decimal rounding rule applies; required dependencies must exist before posting.

### Files to Create/Modify
- `packages/backend/src/modules/erp3/*` — Domain logic, schemas, APIs, and adapters
- `packages/frontend/src/modules/erp3/*` — Module UI pages, tables, and forms
- `tests/modules/erp3/*` — Automated unit, contract, and regression test suites

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Load operations process records in chunks of 500 rows.
- [ ] Transient failures trigger bounded exponential backoff retries without corrupting idempotency keys.
- [ ] Batch execution stops immediately if row failures exceed 10% of attempted rows.

### Context
**Problem:** ERP-4 Finance and Accounting is a primary V1 target module in ClearShift. Its delivery is governed by the SDS and requires production-grade execution for Gate Gate G4.

**Domain Scope:** Owned entities include Chart of accounts, journal entries, journal lines, financial reports (`erp4_accounts, erp4_journal_entries, erp4_journal_lines, erp4_financial_periods`). Non-negotiable business rules: Every posted journal is balanced at currency precision (total debits == total credits); posting is atomic; concurrent posting cannot double-post; invalid/unbalanced journals are rejected with JOURNAL_UNBALANCED; decimal arithmetic only; no live banking/tax filing in V1.

**Cross-Module Dependencies:** ERP-2 vendor bills; ERP-3 invoices/payments; ERP-5 payroll totals; CRM-5 report projections where specified.

**Traceability:** ClearShift Project Plan v3.0, SDS ClearShift ERP v2.0, and V1 Standardization Plan.

### Decision
Implement idempotent retry and partial-load stop behavior strictly conforming to the pinned ClearShift V1 stack. All implementations must integrate with the shared platform libraries rather than creating duplicate local utilities. Enforce chunked batch processing, bounded retries, and immediate batch halting when row failures exceed the 10% threshold.

### Constraints (Non-Negotiable)
- Pinned stack: Node.js 24 LTS, TypeScript strict, Fastify 5, Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL 18.6, React + Vite.
- Zero duplicate platform infrastructure; consume shared auth, UI tokens, outbox, and migration engines.
- All test data must be 100% synthetic; no real personal, customer, or employee data permitted.
- Deterministic exact duplicate matching only; fuzzy scoring and V2 rollback sagas are strictly out of scope.

### Out of Scope
- V2/V3 features (compensating rollback saga, fuzzy duplicate matching, outbound messaging, cloud storage).
- Modifications to schemas owned by other modules without approved API contracts.

### Technical Specification
**Entities & Endpoints:** Bound to Chart of accounts, journal entries, journal lines, financial reports (`erp4_accounts, erp4_journal_entries, erp4_journal_lines, erp4_financial_periods`).
**Operational Logic:** Enforce chunked batch processing, bounded retries, and immediate batch halting when row failures exceed the 10% threshold.
**Error Handling:** Conforms to standard error envelope { code, message, details }. HTTP 400 for bad input, 401/403 for auth, 404 for missing records, 409 for conflicts.
**State Transitions:** Enforces strict domain rules: Every posted journal is balanced at currency precision (total debits == total credits); posting is atomic; concurrent posting cannot double-post; invalid/unbalanced journals are rejected with JOURNAL_UNBALANCED; decimal arithmetic only; no live banking/tax filing in V1.

### Files to Create/Modify
- `packages/backend/src/modules/erp4/*` — Domain logic, schemas, APIs, and adapters
- `packages/frontend/src/modules/erp4/*` — Module UI pages, tables, and forms
- `tests/modules/erp4/*` — Automated unit, contract, and regression test suites

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Load operations process records in chunks of 500 rows.
- [ ] Transient failures trigger bounded exponential backoff retries without corrupting idempotency keys.
- [ ] Batch execution stops immediately if row failures exceed 10% of attempted rows.
- [ ] Already committed rows and receipts remain durable; batch state transitions to STOPPED_EXCESSIVE_FAILURES.
- [ ] No rollback saga or destructive uncommitted data loss occurs.

### Required Closure Evidence
- Linked pull request merged into main with passing CI checks.

### Technical Specification
**Entities & Endpoints:** Bound to Employees, departments, leave records, user roles (`erp5_departments, erp5_employees, erp5_leave_records, erp5_job_roles`).
**Operational Logic:** Enforce chunked batch processing, bounded retries, and immediate batch halting when row failures exceed the 10% threshold.
**Error Handling:** Conforms to standard error envelope { code, message, details }. HTTP 400 for bad input, 401/403 for auth, 404 for missing records, 409 for conflicts.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Load operations process records in chunks of 500 rows.
- [ ] Transient failures trigger bounded exponential backoff retries without corrupting idempotency keys.

Implement idempotent retry and partial-load stop behavior strictly conforming to the pinned ClearShift V1 stack. ### Constraints (Non-Negotiable)
- Pinned stack: Node.js 24 LTS, TypeScript strict, Fastify 5, Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL 18.6, React + Vite.
- Zero duplicate platform infrastructure; consume shared auth, UI tokens, outbox, and migration engines.

- Deterministic exact duplicate matching only; fuzzy scoring and V2 rollback sagas are strictly out of scope.

- Modifications to schemas owned by other modules without approved API contracts.

### Technical Specification
**Entities & Endpoints:** Bound to Deals, pipeline stages, quotes and quote lines (`crm2_deals, crm2_stages, crm2_quotes, crm2_quote_lines`).
**Operational Logic:** Enforce chunked batch processing, bounded retries, and immediate batch halting when row failures exceed the 10% threshold.
**Error Handling:** Conforms to standard error envelope { code, message, details }. HTTP 400 for bad input, 401/403 for auth, 404 for missing records, 409 for conflicts.
**State Transitions:** Enforces strict domain rules: Every deal links to an existing CRM-1 contact/company; stages follow 6 fixed stages (New, Qualified, Proposal, Negotiation, Won, Lost); quote totals are server-computed with decimal arithmetic; product and price references come from ERP-1 API; Won event uses approved event schema.

### Files to Create/Modify
- `packages/backend/src/modules/crm2/*` — Domain logic, schemas, APIs, and adapters
- `packages/frontend/src/modules/crm2/*` — Module UI pages, tables, and forms
- `tests/modules/crm2/*` — Automated unit, contract, and regression test suites

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Load operations process records in chunks of 500 rows.
- [ ] Transient failures trigger bounded exponential backoff retries without corrupting idempotency keys.
- [ ] Batch execution stops immediately if row failures exceed 10% of attempted rows.
- [ ] Already committed rows and receipts remain durable; batch state transitions to STOPPED_EXCESSIVE_FAILURES.
- [ ] No rollback saga or destructive uncommitted data loss occurs.

### Technical Specification
**Entities & Endpoints:** Bound to Support tickets, activities and contact links (`crm3_tickets, crm3_activities, crm3_ticket_notes`).
**Operational Logic:** Enforce chunked batch processing, bounded retries, and immediate batch halting when row failures exceed the 10% threshold.
**Error Handling:** Conforms to standard error envelope { code, message, details }. HTTP 400 for bad input, 401/403 for auth, 404 for missing records, 409 for conflicts.
**State Transitions:** Enforces strict domain rules: Each ticket links to a valid CRM-1 contact/company; status transitions follow documented ticket lifecycle (New -> Open -> Waiting -> Solved -> Closed); priority (Low/Normal/High/Urgent); activity timestamps use ISO 8601 UTC; V1 records history but does not send outbound email/SMS.

- `tests/modules/crm3/*` — Automated unit, contract, and regression test suites

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Load operations process records in chunks of 500 rows.
- [ ] Transient failures trigger bounded exponential backoff retries without corrupting idempotency keys.
- [ ] Batch execution stops immediately if row failures exceed 10% of attempted rows.
- [ ] Already committed rows and receipts remain durable; batch state transitions to STOPPED_EXCESSIVE_FAILURES.

**Error Handling:** Conforms to standard error envelope { code, message, details }. HTTP 400 for bad input, 401/403 for auth, 404 for missing records, 409 for conflicts.

- [ ] Transient failures trigger bounded exponential backoff retries without corrupting idempotency keys.

- V2/V3 features (compensating rollback saga, fuzzy duplicate matching, outbound messaging, cloud storage).
- Modifications to schemas owned by other modules without approved API contracts.

### Technical Specification
**Entities & Endpoints:** Bound to Batch event projections, quality scores, rejects, run summaries and reports (`crm5_run_projections, crm5_quality_scores, crm5_reject_projections, crm5_reconciliation_reports`).
**Operational Logic:** Execute end-to-end reconciliation audit proving exact row accounting, link integrity, and compile the signed Gate G4 acceptance pack.
**Error Handling:** Conforms to standard error envelope { code, message, details }. HTTP 400 for bad input, 401/403 for auth, 404 for missing records, 409 for conflicts.
**State Transitions:** Enforces strict domain rules: Dashboard reads approved event/outcome projections; it is strictly read-only and never mutates other schemas; counts reconcile with source ledger; consumers are idempotent and can replay retained events without inflating counts.

### Files to Create/Modify
- `packages/backend/src/modules/crm5/*` — Domain logic, schemas, APIs, and adapters
- `packages/frontend/src/modules/crm5/*` — Module UI pages, tables, and forms
- `tests/modules/crm5/*` — Automated unit, contract, and regression test suites

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every source row from migration test pack receives exactly one terminal outcome: loaded, rejected, merged, or skipped.
- [ ] Mathematical reconciliation balances exactly: source = loaded + rejected + merged + skipped and unaccounted = 0.
- [ ] All target database records and durable import receipts verify complete and uncorrupted.
- [ ] Signed Gate G4 checklist, CI run URLs, test reports, and live demo recording links are compiled into the archive.
- [ ] Team Lead and Test Manager formally approve Gate G4 sign-off.

### Required Closure Evidence
- Linked pull request merged into main with passing CI checks.
- Automated test suite execution reports demonstrating green passes and >= 60% domain coverage.
- Data dictionary, schema definitions, and OpenAPI contract documentation updated.
- Peer review sign-off by another development group.

### Dependencies
Direct prerequisites: CRM5-07, CRM5-08, CRM5-13, CRM5-23, CRM5-28, CRM5-29, KIT-09. Dependent work cannot begin until all listed dependencies are closed with verified evidence.

### Deferred Decisions
None. Scope is strictly locked to approved V1 specifications.
